objective: Fix blurred Android fullscreen BUKLOD Character progression images (Christian Level 3 example) while maintaining the approved clear web rendering, image framing, levels, and performant thumbnails.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main at 63ccd4b contained approved R31 .tsx sprite renderer with react-native Image resizeMethod=scale for all sizes, a 4940px-wide sprite sheet of 20 character levels, and immutable character UI visual hash locks. User-provided 2026-11-16 screenshots show Android zoom visibly blurrier than web. This PR does not claim live production OTA or physical-device verification.
chosenApproach: Use Metro's platform-specific .android.tsx companion to decode the original 4940px sprite at full quality only for enlarged Android views, keep React Native's inexpensive downscaled path for small avatars/cards, preserve the base web implementation and character server rules, and fall back to the original image component on decode errors.
selectionRationale: The Android-only companion fixes decode/resampling independently without rewriting approved R31 web/selector visual blobs, changing asset hashes or causing a full-quality bitmap decode in every small card. Expo-image is already a dependency.
alternativeApproaches: Replace the existing shared R31 renderer with expo-image everywhere: rejected because it touches locked web visuals and adds memory/cross-platform regression risk.
Generate new high-resolution artwork for each of the 100 core levels: not part of this quality/decoder defect and assets are not yet approved.
Upscale decoded Android preview via CSS/native transform: rejected because interpolating thumbnail pixels does not restore quality.
preserveBehaviors: Current Android preview size, crop, and 20-level row alignment for Phan, Quin, Van, Christian and Lhen.
Web/iOS approved R31 renderer, R40 specials, Character customization, and Circle Rank remain unchanged.
No changes to point/level backend authority, per-character persistence, identity, profile data, or collectible ownership.
Normal small thumbnails stay memory-efficient; Expo image decode failure returns to existing renderer.
Ads, navigation, performance, audio, PTT, and production runtime/version identity are untouched.
acceptanceChecks: Android enlarged Character view resolves the .android.tsx component and decodes full source without upscaling a previously downsampled bitmap.
Small Android preview/roster/card images retain existing lightweight path and identical R31 cropping.
Every 1-20 level remains mapped to its correct sprite cell for all five core characters.
Node regression contract, character release gate, TypeScript/Expo build and staging Android image review pass before production OTA.
Full-source sprite decode stays below device bitmap safety thresholds; no mass prefetch or 20-image batch decode.
Physical-device verification is not claimed; production remains unchanged until verified staging RC.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: New Android-specific Character image renderer changes the native decoded bitmap path only for enlarged previews.
preservedBehaviors: No new native dependencies, runtime changes, production OTA, or unrelated screen changes.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Improve five core characters' Android zoom fidelity without altering Character authority, source artwork, 20-level crop, or unlock rules.
preservedBehaviors: Preserve per-character XP, level and Circle Rank continuity and existing R31/R40 presentation contracts.

releaseTarget: Staging Android runtime 1.3.2; promote only after verified RC and mandatory gates.
